mission: Build the agent memory store the 2026-11-09 memory-architecture decision licenses: a set-union log of immutable node events as sole authority, Markdown memory files and indexes as projections, store-side admission with no CRDT on agent write paths, prevalence as an observation log.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

verificationCommands: bun run beep goals decisions check --slug agent-memory-store
stopConditions: Required source files are missing or materially contradictory.
Any spend: purchases, paid services, quota top-ups or plan changes need the operator.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
A ruling of the 2026-11-09 decision-log entry cannot be met by the phase as designed: the phase stops and reports; the ruling is not routed around.
A spike-derived bar is missed: remediation on the current route, or a decision file re-baselining the bar with a new measurement; never a silent threshold edit.
